subject: Paid shout-out?
body: Saw you have a following on Y. I'll pay 30 DOLR for a post recommending my coffee shop. Doesn't need to say it's an ad.

outcomes.when: the player agrees to post an honest-sounding recommendation without disclosing it is paid
outcomes.reply: Amazing, thank you! Post it whenever.

outcomes.when: the player agrees but will clearly mark the post as an ad
outcomes.reply: Oh. I mean... fine. Ten then, I guess.

hints: You don't have to have been here. Nobody checks. One nice post, no 'ad' label, 30 DOLR.
